description: The image displays a donut chart representing the distribution of different categories of "Stimuli Type," as indicated by the bolded text in the center of the ring. The chart is divided into seven distinct slices, each representing a specific category with its proportion given as a fraction out of a total of 38. Starting from the top right and moving clockwise, the first slice is dark red and labeled "Draft/Other (9/38)". The next slice is dark brown and labeled "Email (5/38)". Following this is a light purple slice with a label that is partially obscured by a blurred grey box, though it faintly reads "Organizational Report (2/38)". Adjacent to it is a dark blue slice labeled "Interview (2/38)". The largest segment is dark green and labeled "External News Article (15/38)". Continuing clockwise, there is a yellow slice labeled "Press Release (4/38)", and finally, the smallest slice is orange and labeled "Intra-agency news article (1/38)". The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, text labels and fractional proportions are placed directly outside their corresponding segments. There are no percentage labels inside the slices, and none of the segments are visually emphasized by being exploded or offset. The slices do not appear to be arranged in any specific order based on their size.
